assignments.reason: Longevity/length-of-days is essentially a dimension of ימים (days) and מדות (measures) — the bounded vessel structure through which divine vitality flows. The Torah says 'למען יאריך ימים על ממלכתו' — the days themselves, extended, are the vessel. Its essential nature is the measure/vessel of life, which is the domain of Package 5 (Torah and Measures). Torah produces it, but it IS days-in-their-fullness.

Redemption (geulah) in this Torah is essentially a manifestation of daat. The Rebbe states: 'עיקר הגאלה על ידי הדעת' (line 63) and 'וידעתם כי ה' הוציא אתכם' — redemption IS the revelation of daat. Moses, who IS daat (already in Package 1), was the redeemer precisely because he IS daat. Geulah's essential nature in this Torah is the actualization of daat in the world.

assignments.node_id: יוכל לידע שאפלו בתוך ההסתרה בעצמה, ואפלו בתוך ההסתרה שבתוך הסתרה, גם שם מלבש השם יתברך, דהינו התורה. ומאחר שיודע שאפלו בתוך ההסתרות יש שם השם יתברך, מזה בעצמו נתגלין ההסתרות, ונעשה מהם תורה. ואפלו מהסתרה שבתוך הסתרה, נעשה תורה.
assignments.reason: This long node describes the core daat operation: knowing that God is hidden even within the double concealment, and through that knowing itself, transforming concealment into Torah. This IS the function and expression of daat — it is knowledge/awareness operating on concealment. Its essential nature is daat itself (the act of knowing-within-concealment).

assignments.node_id: יכולים לקרב ולהוכיח את מי שצריכין להוכיח
assignments.reason: The ability to draw near and rebuke those who need rebuking is essentially a function of holy malkhut. The entire Torah opens with malkhut as the capacity of each person to govern and warn (צופה, sections א-ב). The obligation to rebuke flows from one's measure of sovereignty. While daat enables it, rebuking IS the exercise of holy malkhut — it is what the king/leader does with their authority for God's sake.

assignments.node_id: כשמקבלין את החיות, צריך לקבלם במדה. כי בלא מדה וצמצום אי אפשר לקבל את החיות מהשם יתברך, מחמת רבוי אור, כי רבוי השמן גורם כבוי הנר, על־כן צריך לקבל החיות במדה
assignments.reason: This node describes receiving vitality through bounded measures (מדה/צמצום). Its essential nature is the measure-and-vessel principle — the very thing that defines Package 5. Torah provides the vessel, and this node IS the principle of measured reception of divine light. Without measure, vitality cannot be received. This is the core identity of the Torah-as-vessel concept.

assignments.node_id: ממשיך אריכות ימים לתוך המלכות, שהוא בחינת דעת
assignments.reason: Drawing length-of-days INTO malkhut is essentially a malkhut concept — it is the process of sustaining and vivifying the kingdom. The node describes malkhut being filled with daat/life. Its essential nature is the reception side (malkhut as recipient), which is why the text frames it as 'into the malkhut.' The malkhut is the subject being sustained.

Revealing the concealments is the essential function of daat in this Torah. The Rebbe says (line 27): 'צריך לגלות ההסתרות הנ"ל, וזה על ידי שממשיך אריכות ימים לתוך המלכות, שהוא בחינת דעת.' The act of revelation IS daat in action. The הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה is already in the daat package — and revealing it is what daat does.

Wisdom-and-knowledge (חכמה ודעת) is essentially daat. In this Torah, the Rebbe uses 'חכמה ודעת' in line 30 as a compound referring to the same faculty of knowing that transforms concealments into Torah. It is the central concept of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מגלין ההסתרות, ועושין מהם תורה כנ"ל, על ידי זה "פיה פתחה". הינו בחינת אוריתא מכרזת קמיהו, שהתורה בעצמה פותחת פיה ומוכיחה אותם כנ"ל
assignments.reason: This node describes Torah opening her mouth and proclaiming/rebuking. Its essential nature is Torah-as-living-voice (אוריתא מכרזת קמיהו). While חכמה ודעת is the cause, the node itself describes what TORAH does — Torah herself proclaims and rebukes. The subject is Torah acting autonomously, which places it in the Torah domain (Package 5).

The sigh (אנחה) is essentially a breath/spirit phenomenon — it belongs to the domain of the pulse (רוח הדופק). The Rebbe describes it (lines 72, 76) as the means of reviving and healing the beating pulse, purifying the hands/heavens. Its essential nature is a spiritual-physical breath that restores the pulse's proper rhythm. It IS a ruach (spirit/breath) phenomenon, placing it in Package 4.

assignments.node_id: מחיה ומבריא את הרוח הדופק, ונצול מהעצבות רוח. וחוזר הרוח הדופק ומנשב כסדר בכל האיברים, ובפרט בהידים. ועל ידי זה מזכך את השמים
assignments.reason: This node describes the healing and restoration of the beating pulse, the purification of the heavens via the hands. Every element — רוח הדופק, hands, heavens, the ordered blowing — is a core concept of Package 4. Its essential nature is the restored state of the pulse-and-heaven system.

assignments.node_id: מחלקת לשם שמים, צריך לזכך ולטהר את השמים, שלא יהיה בבחינת (ישעיה נ): "אלביש שמים קדרות". ולזכך ולטהר את השמים
assignments.reason: This node describes the purification of the heavens as a prerequisite for holy controversy. Its essential nature is the שמים (heavens) domain — purifying the heavens so they are not darkened. The שמים node is already in Package 4, and this describes the state of purified heavens. While machloket lishem shamayim is in Package 1, the purification of shamayim IS a heavens/pulse concept.

assignments.node_id: ממשיכין אריכות ימים לתוך המלכות, כי על ידה ממשיכין החיות לתוך הימים והמדות כנ"ל, ועל־ידי זה זוכין לדעת כנ"ל. על־ידי־זה יכולין להוכיח אפלו את הרחוקים מאד מהשם יתברך, בבחינת הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה כנ"ל:
assignments.reason: This comprehensive summary node describes the full chain culminating in rebuking the most distant people. Its framing subject is malkhut — drawing life into the kingdom and thereby being able to rebuke even those in the deepest concealment. This is the total expression of what holy malkhut achieves when properly sustained. The essential nature is the fulfilled function of holy sovereignty.

assignments.node_id: ממשיכין אריכות ימים, ואז זוכה לדעת
assignments.reason: Drawing length-of-days and then meriting daat: this is a bridge concept, but its essential nature is the measure/days framework. The node describes the process of drawing vitality through the vessel of days-and-measures (Torah's function). The subject is the drawing of length-of-days — the activation of the Torah/measures vessel.

The increase/expansion of daat is essentially daat itself growing. Its nature IS daat — specifically, daat in its expanding, proliferating dimension. The node describes the quantitative growth of the central concept of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מתרבה הרחמנות והשלום. ועל כן הפרנסה בנקל
assignments.reason: Increased compassion and peace, leading to easy livelihood: in this Torah, rachamim and shalom are expressions of daat (line 52: Shavuot = chesed elyon = rachamim gedolim, all flowing from daat). שלום is already in Package 1. The essential nature of this compound outcome — compassion, peace, easy livelihood — is the manifested state of abundant daat in the world.

The growth of peace is essentially שלום, which is already in Package 1 as a bechina of דעת. Peace depends on daat ('שלום תלוי בדעת', line 51). The enlarged peace IS daat manifesting as harmony between opposites.

assignments.node_id: מזה בעצמו שיודע שגם בתוך הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה יש שם השם יתברך
assignments.reason: The very knowing that God is present within the double concealment — this IS daat in its purest form. The node describes the act of knowing (ידיעה), which is the essential operation of Package 1. The הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה is already in the daat package; this node is the daat-awareness that penetrates it.

The concealment becoming daat/Torah: this transformation is the central thesis of the Torah. When the concealment is recognized, it 'becomes daat, that is, Torah.' The essential nature is daat itself — the state of transformed knowing. While it also mentions Torah, the 'דהיינו תורה' is explaining what daat IS (daat = Torah), and in this Torah, daat is the primary concept.

The nullification of anger and cruelty: the Rebbe states (line 51) 'כעס ואכזריות הוא מהעדר הדעת' — anger/cruelty come from LACK of daat. Their nullification is the presence of daat. The essential nature of this state IS daat — it is what daat looks like in the emotional domain. Without daat = anger; with daat = its nullification.

Knowing that God is hidden there — this is pure daat/awareness/knowledge. The act of knowing (ידיעה) IS daat. The Rebbe says (line 28): 'תכף כשיודעין שהשם יתברך נסתר שם, על ידי זה בעצמו נתהפכה ההסתרה.' This knowing IS daat operating.

assignments.node_id: נתהפכה ההסתרה שבתוך ההסתרה, ונעשה ממנה דעת, והחזרה התורה שנסתר כאן, לדעת, מאחר שיודע שהשם יתברך נסתר שם. וכיון שנחזר ההסתרה שבתוך הסתרה לדעת, ונעשה ממנה תורה, אזי התורה בעצמה מוכיחה אותם, בבחינת: אוריתא מכרזת קמיהו עד מתי פתיים תאהבו פתי
assignments.reason: This comprehensive node describes the full transformation: double concealment flips into daat, which becomes Torah, which then rebukes. The essential nature is the transformative process of daat — the central thesis of the entire Torah. It is daat in its fullest expression: converting concealment to awareness to Torah to proclamation. The dominant concept throughout is daat.

According to the growth of daat — this is daat itself in its expanding dimension. Appears in edges leading to both peace and easy livelihood. Its essential nature is daat quantified/measured — the growth of the central concept of Package 1.

Easy livelihood: the Rebbe says (line 50) 'פרנסה בנקל תולה בדעת' and illustrates with the manna (= daat). Those who lack daat toil for livelihood; those with daat receive it easily. In this Torah, easy livelihood IS the material expression of daat-abundance. The manna — which is the symbol of daat (Package 1) — is the paradigm of effortless sustenance. Parnasah benakeil is what daat-in-the-world looks like materially.

assignments.node_id: קורא את החיות לתוך הימים והמדות
assignments.reason: Calling vitality into the days and measures: this IS the function of Torah as described in section ג. Torah calls (קורא) the divine life-force into the vessels of days/measures. The essential nature is the vessel-filling process — Torah activating the days/measures framework. The subject is the ימים and מדות being filled, which is the core of Package 5.

Calling forth the length-of-days: this describes the Torah-study act of summoning/drawing longevity. The essential nature is the calling-forth of days (ימים = measures = Torah's vessel). Torah as God's name calls life into days. This is a Torah/measures concept — the activation of the day-vessel through Torah study.

Healing/remedy: the Rebbe says (line 69) 'מצה היא אסותא' — matzah is the remedy, because matzah = machloket lishem shamayim = daat = shalom, and shalom = healing. Illness comes from lack of shalom (= lack of daat), and healing IS the restoration of shalom/daat. In this Torah, רפואה is what happens when daat/shalom is restored to the body's elements. Its essential nature is the shalom-of-daat manifesting as physical wholeness.
